BY COLLECTOR
FINAL NOTIFICATION
No. Jr. cl.-WS-70-Rajaswa-4-2026.----
In exercise of the powers of State Government under the proviso to sub-section (1) of Section 4 of the Maharashtra
Land Revenue Code, 1966 (Mah.XLI of 1966) Delegated to me by Govt. Notification Revenue and Forest Department No.
TLC-1076-63923-M-6-Dated 1st July, 1976 and after previous publication as required by sub-section (4) of the said
section 4, I, Vikas Meena, the Collector, Yavatmal District with effect from Date 6th May, 2026 constitute the RAMNAGAR
wadi in the ARNI Taluka of the Yavatmal to be village to be called RAMNAGAR in the Taluka the ARNI Taluka of the said
District, having the limits specified in the Schedule here to appended.---
